cd /workspace && cat > tmp/timing.py << 'PYEOF'
import random,json,subprocess,sys,time,resource
random.seed(11)
toks=['a','b']
pats=[[random.choice(toks) for _ in range(16)] for _ in range(8)]
atoms=[{'op':'contains','path':p} for p in pats]
def build(depth):
    if depth<=0: return random.choice(atoms)
    op='and' if depth%2 else 'or'
    return {'op':op,'args':[build(depth-1) for _ in range(2)]}
lines=[]
req={'services':toks,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':build(7)}],'queries':[[],['a'],['b','a']*200]}
for _ in range(6): lines.append(json.dumps(req))
lines.append(json.dumps({'services':['a'],'rules':[],'queries':[]}))
lines.append('not json')
payload=('\n'.join(lines)).encode()+b'\n'
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v',sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True)
dt=time.time()-t
print("rc",p.returncode,"wall",round(dt,2),"nlines_out",len(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()))
print(p.stderr.decode()[-600:])
PYEOF
